field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefixed (success_e3_ar25_L1_reproduced or complete_e3_ar25_partial_model_<acc>). A reproduced L1 solve and an honest partial (induced model + residual gap) are BOTH progress per the operator E3 spec.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: BARE bool: the real env reaches L1 via the induced-model plan, re-gated by arc_solver_kit.reproduce() -- only reproduced levels count (ARC Solve Reproducibility).
field_principles.plan_executed: BARE bool + divergence_step: execution-grounded confirmation; halt-on-divergence prevents trusting a wrong model.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records the offline-env presence + harness import + TRM-stand-down; pre-empts the silent-missing-resource fabrication mode.
field_principles.random_seed: Determinism precondition for the induction + planning.
field_principles.reproduced_levels: BARE int: levels offline-reproduced on ar25 -- the +1 incremental-progress unit (target >=1).
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash of the world model + the plan + the reproduce() result; lets a third party re-run.
field_principles.verifier_accuracy_per_round: list[float]: the verifier is the moat; its reproduction rate per refactor round is the only trustworthy progress signal for the induced model (validated 61% on ar25).
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: BARE bool=true -- the SOLVE is EXECUTION-GROUNDED (the real env defines the win), so an E3 solve is ARC NORTH-STAR PROGRESS, NOT an oracle-distinct verifier-moat headline (the moat is the separate Phase A track).
field_principles.world_model_path: results/arc_e3/ar25/world_model.py -- the induced model IS the deliverable.
field_principles.world_model_sha256: Hash of the induced world model -- makes the solve auditable/reproducible.
